_comment: Every word the game shows. Edit this file to change any text; no JavaScript involved. Keys are referenced from index.html via data-text attributes and from code via t('some.key'). {braces} are values the game fills in at runtime — keep them spelled exactly as they are, but they can be moved around inside the sentence or dropped if you don't want them shown.

start.intro: GET OUT OF BOGOTÁ! Traffic is a nightmare. There's a bollard in the middle of the road. A trash can blocking the way. Three potholes ahead. Don't ask. RUN.

over.newBest: New best! {score} meters away from the center of Bogotá.
over.gameOver: You made {score}. Bogotá got you. Too many obstacles. Too many potholes. And definitely too many bollards.

pause.body: Take a breather. Press ESC or hit resume to keep running.

leaderboard.empty: No scores yet — be the first.

footer: Character art: Hugo Torres · Arrow keys or on-screen controls · Space also jumps
